S01: 黄征 leads north toward the entrance, with 队长 two metres behind and four anonymous officers spreading into alert supporting positions. Begin immediately in a southern distant wide view looking north, showing their backs, the complete unfinished concrete building, empty window openings and the route into the entrance. Keep environmental depth; no face introduction or portrait insert. Rapid boots and rattling equipment accompany muffled gunfire from inside to the north. End with the team still approaching.

At 00:04.000 cut to the east of the doorway looking west, in a full view with the complete doorway and team. North is screen-right: their right profiles remain oriented toward the entrance as they lower their posture behind the existing pillars. 黄征 reaches the threshold to observe; 队长 and the four officers establish covering positions without entering yet. Dull indoor gunshots remain beyond the north-facing route; no dialogue. End ready to cross the threshold, not already inside.
S02: 黄征 and 队长 cross the threshold and advance north between the bare concrete pillars. Two anonymous armed gang members fire south from a northern doorway and a farther column. Police return fire from existing cover, aiming at those opponents. The camera is east looking west in a medium-long spatial view: police south at screen-left, attackers north at screen-right, with the route visible. Northern muzzle flashes, harsh concrete reverberation and small falling chips convey immediate danger without obscuring the action.

From four to eight seconds the doorway gunman is struck, collapses and drops his weapon; the second retreats toward the northern column. The police advance by one cover position without repeating their entrance. Track north on the same east side, keeping the fallen attacker and remaining opponent in the wide frame. A short burst gives way to a brief pause and urgent boots. The fallen man remains down and disarmed.

From eight to twelve seconds the remaining corridor gunman attempts to fire and is struck; his pistol slides away as he falls. Supporting police stay to control both fallen attackers and their weapons. 黄征 and 队长 pursue toward the north-end stairs; neither fallen attacker appears in the later pursuit. Keep the eastern view looking west, north screen-right, and the captured ground behind at screen-left. Nearby firing stops; scattered shots from upstairs to the north motivate the next transition. End at the stair approach.
S03: Begin with a hard cut that omits the intervening climb from the lower corridor to a higher staircase. An empty window now affords a downward view of neighbouring low rooftops; an unfinished brick gap and stair landings distinguish this higher location from the previous corridor. From an elevated east-side camera looking west in a full view, 黄征 and 队长 pursue while the last armed subordinate blocks the upper landing. A supporting anonymous police officer shoots him; he falls and loses his weapon, and police secure him. Only the two principal officers and anonymous fighters occupy this view. Urgent feet, a short exchange and distant lower-floor firing; no dialogue. This is elapsed time, not instant teleportation.

At 00:04.000 cut within the established higher stair space to an east-side full view looking west of 贩毒头目 controlling 周诚 with his left arm. He drags the hostage up the actual switchback route, side-stepping or backing as necessary to keep his right-hand pistol trained down toward the pursuing 黄征. 周诚 stumbles in light-grey work clothes; show his distinct adult face. Only boss and hostage are framed; both pursuing officers remain below offscreen. Turn only around the real landing, never merely to face the lens. Dragging feet and suppressed panting replace the exchange of fire. The boss is now the only armed resisting gang member.

At 00:07.000 make a second hard cut omitting the remaining ascent. The final landing has no upward continuation; open sky and exposed roof concrete are visible beyond the northern iron doorway, proving a different, terminal level. Hold an east-side eye-level full view. 贩毒头目 forces 周诚 out first; only after both have left the frame do 黄征 and 队长 enter the shot from the stairs. Show at most two principals at once. The northern doorway is screen-right; all continue along the established route. Hinges scrape and outdoor wind enters.

From nine to twelve seconds 黄征 and 队长 stop inside the threshold to observe, both facing north; neither crosses onto the roof. 贩毒头目 and 周诚 continue offscreen to the northern equipment plinths. Lower-floor police keep control of the fallen subordinate without teleporting to this landing. Maintain the east-side full view and visible threshold. Boots stop, leaving breathing, cloth and strengthening wind. End with both officers inside the southwest roof exit, ready to emerge next clip.
S04: 黄征 and 队长 emerge from the southwest doorway facing north. 黄征 is about three metres north of the south parapet; 队长 stays to his western rear. The boss and hostage are offscreen to the north. Begin in an eastern full two-person view looking west: north screen-right, southern parapet screen-left, both figures around thirty percent of frame height. Preserve the complete exit and parapet. Wind sweeps across the unfinished roof; no dialogue yet.

At 00:03.000 cut to a full two-person view of 贩毒头目 and 周诚 at the northern masonry plinths, from east-southeast looking northwest. His left arm controls 周诚; his right-hand pistol points south toward the offscreen 黄征, independent of the camera. 周诚 stands stiffly at his left arm. Both officers stay outside the frame. 贩毒头目, a rough urgent male voice (S3), shouts on screen: <d>[Mandarin Chinese] 别过来！把枪放下！</d> Wind and tense cloth movement continue.

At 00:05.000 cut back to the eastern full two-officer view. 队长 looks at 黄征 and, in a low clipped male command voice (S2), says on screen: <d>[Mandarin Chinese] 你去谈，把枪放下。</d> 黄征 remains north-facing and prepares to lower himself. Boss and hostage stay offscreen at the north plinths; no invented movement.

From seven to ten seconds 黄征 slowly crouches, places his pistol on the concrete beside the southwest exit, rises and raises both visibly empty hands beside his head. Hold the full two-person framing with the grounded pistol and headroom visible, no face or weapon insert. 队长 stays southwest without blocking the northern line of sight. A light metal contact, controlled breath, cloth and wind accompany the action. The pistol stays on the ground for all subsequent scenes; no second gun is produced.
S05: From the north, 贩毒头目, the same rough male voice (S3), says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Mandarin Chinese] 靠边，慢慢走！</d> while the visible 黄征 and 队长 keep their lips closed. This voice belongs to the physically present boss outside the frame, not a narrator. 黄征 keeps his torso north and both hands raised, sidesteps east along the southern strip and takes a small backward step toward the low parapet. Begin in the east-side full view looking west with only 黄征 and the more distant 队长 visible; south is screen-left. Lateral movement approaches the camera without turning his body. Soles scrape under continuous wind.

From two to four seconds 黄征 stops in front of the low parapet with hands still raised and says in a steady but urgent male voice (S1): <d>[Mandarin Chinese] 先放人，有话好说。</d> Keep the east-side medium-long full-body framing, his right profile visible, the low wall behind him and 队长 southwest behind. Boss and hostage remain offscreen north. Reduce wind audibility slightly under the line without changing its source.

At 00:04.000 cut to the southeast full two-person view of the northern plinths. 贩毒头目 still points the gun south at 黄征 and says (S3): <d>[Mandarin Chinese] 让你们的人退后！</d> 周诚 shrinks tensely in his grip. Both officers remain offscreen. His delivery grows uncontrolled without swinging the gun toward the lens.

At 00:06.000 cut back to the eastern two-officer spatial view. 黄征, still with empty raised hands, says (S1): <d>[Mandarin Chinese] 我没有枪，别伤他。</d> 队长 shifts only half a step west to obtain an unobstructed sightline, pistol still lowered. The low wall behind 黄征 and the captain's southwest position remain explicit. 黄征 takes no further backward step. Complete the line before the clip ends; light shoe contact and wind continue.
S06: 贩毒头目 notices the captain's new position, turns his head southwest toward 队长 and shouts with the same rough male voice (S3): <d>[Mandarin Chinese] 你出卖我们！</d> His right-hand pistol nevertheless remains pointed south at 黄征. When his left-arm grip loosens, 周诚 ducks west behind the masonry plinth. The camera is east looking west in a medium-long view focused on boss and hostage; both officers are offscreen. Clearly separate his head turn from his gun direction. Finish the accusation once, with frightened panting and cloth friction under the wind.

At 00:04.000 cut to an eastern wide view looking west that contains exactly three principal figures: 队长 southwest, 黄征 near the southern parapet farther east, 贩毒头目 at the northern plinth. 周诚 is now crouched out of view behind the western side of the plinth, clear of both lines of fire. 队长 realizes exposure and quickly raises his pistol northeast toward the boss; the boss still aims south at 黄征. Keep both target relationships and the parapet visible. A short breath and sleeve movement precede any shot.

At about 6.2 seconds 队长 fires one shot at 贩毒头目 to silence him. At about 6.3 seconds, before collapsing from the hit, 贩毒头目 pulls his trigger at his already-established target 黄征, striking the front of his chest. Maintain the eastern spatial wide view: two brief muzzle flashes belong to two different shooters and two distinct targets. The boss then falls against the plinth and drops his gun. Do not show him shooting after death, do not redirect the captain's bullet toward 黄征, and do not insert a graphic wound close-up. Two closely spaced but distinguishable gunshots and short echoes overpower the wind.

From eight to ten seconds 黄征's raised empty hands sink and his breath catches; he is still standing at the south edge. 队长's gun remains aimed at the fallen boss. 周诚 stays alive, curled behind the western plinth, outside the frame. Keep the established triangle without resetting positions or reviving the boss. Echoes decay and wind returns; 黄征 cannot speak. End before his backward fall.
S07: 黄征 looks north toward the fallen boss outside the frame, then painfully turns his head southwest toward 队长's gun still directed at that boss. His breath stops and his gaze fixes in recognition: the accusation named the captain, and the captain fired to silence its speaker. His lips attempt a word but nothing intelligible emerges. Start from east-southeast in a medium-long view of only 黄征 and 队长, showing the former's right-rear body and motivated head turn while his torso stays broadly north. Do not replay either shot, insert a flashback or add explanatory text. Broken breathing and roof wind only.

At 00:04.000 cut to an eastern full view looking west with head, feet and parapet visible. 黄征, wounded in the chest and empty-handed, loses support, staggers backward south and catches the backs of his legs on the low parapet; his centre of gravity tips beyond it. South and the backward fall are screen-left. 队长 remains west of the fall path. This is loss of balance, not a bullet launching a body. Soles scrape and clothing brushes concrete as the wind rises.

From eight to twelve seconds 黄征 tips face-up beyond the south edge and his feet leave the roof. Smoothly follow down from the same eastern exterior side, retaining the unfinished facade and the drop, with his chest facing the sky. 队长 stays above to the west. The boss and 周诚 remain offscreen north: the boss is down, 周诚 concealed and alive; neither follows the falling man. Air rush overtakes roof sounds. No ground impact or vortex yet; end in the same ongoing fall.
S08: Continue the same face-up fall, 黄征's hands empty and the existing chest-hit mark on his clothing. He cannot speak. Begin in an eastern exterior long view looking west and tracking downward outside the southern bare concrete facade; show the complete body and changing roof/ground distances. Subjective time stretches his fear without claiming a specific building height or a fresh fall. Harsh wind and a muffled heartbeat swallow sounds above.

At 00:04.000 cut to his upward-looking subjective perception only at the instant he reaches the ground. A fierce black vortex seems to surge toward his face, consuming the sky and unfinished concrete silhouette. Do not place a portal high in the air, change the falling pose or show a graphic impact. Rushing air compresses into a low swirling roar.

From six to eight seconds he closes his eyes and perception falls naturally to black, without explaining death or rescue. No visible body remains; never dissolve the modern and ancient faces together. The swirl fades and a first horse breath bridges into the black before any ancient body appears. No dialogue, caption or replay.
S09: After black, establish 华雄 already seated on a tall dark bay horse, body and horse facing north, right hand holding the red-tasselled spear and left the reins. Consciousness returns and his eyes begin opening within this independent ancient body. Begin from the east looking west in a slightly elevated full view, complete rider and horse around thirty percent of image height. The southern gate and dense friendly ranks are screen-left behind him; the opposing northern army spreads across screen-right in the distance, without identifying 潘凤 yet. Preserve a broad open lane and layered banners, spears and shields. Do not begin with a face morph or portrait. Continue the horse breath from black with leather creaks, open wind and low human-and-horse murmur from both armies.

From five to ten seconds 华雄 opens his eyes to harsh sunlight and feels the horse shift slightly beneath him; his right-hand spear tip catches the sun. Keep the same eastern full view of his right side and the complete horse; identity reads through distinct physique, armour and silhouette without a facial insert. Neither a remount nor a new weapon pickup occurs. Both armies keep their ranks, with flags moving in the wind and the lane clear. Horse breath, light armour and distant ranks persist; no dialogue or mass charge. End awake and mounted.
S10: Already awake, 华雄 lowers his eyes toward his right-hand spear, armour and left-hand reins. His grip hesitates briefly, mouth closed; no modern-body flashback. Continue the east-side view looking west, north screen-right, showing the complete horse and rider at roughly thirty-five percent of height in front of his own southern ranks. Small armour clicks, leather friction, horse breathing and distant troop murmur continue.

At 00:04.000 cut to about eight metres northeast looking southwest, in a knee-up medium view of his right-front body, saddle, hands and spear. 华雄 raises his gaze across the unfamiliar landscape while his torso and horse remain north-facing. The southern friendly army and gate stay behind him. A pause in movement conveys the absurd mismatch of memory and body without a modern joke. No turn merely to show the face, and no push-in. Wind in banners and distant human-and-horse sounds; he stays silent.

From eight to twelve seconds distant hoofbeats from the north draw 华雄's alert gaze upward; spear stays right, reins left, horse remains planted. Hold the northeast camera; the approaching sound is north behind the camera and still offscreen. He looks toward that northern source rather than turning south. The troop positions remain stable and the new hoofbeats are distinct from the distant ranks. End ready to see the challenger, with no attack yet.
S11: About one hundred metres north, 潘凤 sits mounted in front of the northern enemy formation, facing south with spear ready. He delivers his whole challenge before accelerating. Cut to the eastern spatial wide view looking west: 华雄 and his southern army on screen-left, 潘凤 and the northern army on screen-right, with the full gap between. Both armies extend laterally in deep spear-and-shield ranks and banners; this is not two isolated men in a desert. 潘凤, a booming male voice (S4), calls on screen: <d>[Mandarin Chinese] 华雄匹夫，我潘凤来也！</d> 华雄 recognizes that the name addresses him, with lips closed. Finish the full Mandarin line once.

From four to eight seconds only 潘凤 urges his horse south, black robe rising as he closes from the initial hundred-metre position. 华雄 remains mounted to the south without swinging his spear. Continue the same eastern wide view, the advancing rider moving right-to-left while both armies hold position. Dust and robe motion follow the horse's movement; do not start a general charge. Hoofbeats grow, with robe flaps and wind, and the challenge is not repeated. End in the ongoing approach with a substantial gap remaining.
S12: 华雄 instinctively tightens his right-hand grip on the spear and his left on the reins; shock becomes survival alertness, mouth closed. 潘凤 continues the north-to-south approach outside the frame. Cut to a northeast camera looking southwest, knee-up on 华雄's right-front body with saddle and hands, friendly southern ranks and gate behind him. Do not turn horse or rider, make him stand, or grant sudden martial expertise. Approaching hoofbeats remain uninterrupted from the north behind the camera, over taut tack and armour clicks; no internal spoken exposition.

At 00:05.000 cut back to the eastern full spatial view looking west. 潘凤 continues southward toward 华雄, who checks his horse but has not attacked or evaded. Keep both entire horses, their closing gap, dust, horizon and armies behind their respective champions visible. South is screen-left, north screen-right. About twenty to thirty metres still separate them at the end: spear points do not touch, the first exchange belongs to the next episode. End on continued approach rather than a forced freeze. Strong hoofbeats, robe flaps, wind and low distant troop sound continue; no narrator or caption substitutes for the suspense.
